title: Donut chart
description: Use to show parts of a whole (shares, budget split): a donut that sweeps open with a total and a legend. Transparent overlay with light text by default (theme 'dark'): put it on a dark backdrop, or pass theme="light" for light backdrops.
props: {data: {label: string; value: number; color?: string}[]; centerLabel?: string /*'Total'*/; palette?: string[]; startFrame?: number /*5*/; durationInFrames?: number /*45*/; fontFamily?: string; textColor?: string; theme?: 'dark'|'light' /*'dark'*/}
